steps.title: This is you
steps.text: You play Ruth: the gold YOU tag over her head and on her picture at the top says so. The camera follows her. Everyone else has a mind of their own.

steps.title: Walk
steps.text: W A S D walk Ruth, and the camera goes with her. Take a few steps around the yard. The walls keep the dead out, and keep you in.
steps.goal: walk six steps with W A S D

steps.title: Aim and shoot
steps.text: A walker is coming to the north wall. Shots stop at its face, so climb the marked ladder to the walkway. Then hold the right mouse button to aim, and click to shoot.
steps.text_always: A walker is coming to the north wall. Shots stop at its face, so climb the marked ladder to the walkway. Then aim with the mouse and hold the left button.
steps.goal: climb the ladder to the walkway

goals.text: hold the right mouse button to aim at the walker

goals_always.text: aim at the walker, hold the left button

steps.title: Reload and put away
steps.text: The gun holds a few rounds: R reloads it, and the readout under the clock shows the magazine over the stores. Q puts the weapon away, and Q again draws it.

goals.text: press Q again to draw it
press Q to put the weapon away

steps.title: Ask, do not order
steps.text: Nobody takes orders: you ask, over the radio. Click Dez's picture at the top, then press Come with me. Ana is nursing Walt: ask her too, and see why she cannot.
steps.goal: click Dez, then press Come with me

goals.text: watch Dez and Ana come to you
press Insist: she comes, and trusts you less
now click Ana, then press Come with me

steps.title: The radio wheel
steps.text: Quicker than the buttons: hold C and a ring of orders opens at the pointer, for Dez. Move onto Hold here and let go: he stays where you pointed.
steps.goal: hold C and pick Hold here

goals.text: move onto Hold here, then let go of C

steps.title: The gate and the bell
steps.text: Late afternoon: the gate stands open for the day's comings and goings. At 19:00 the bell rings and the dead come. Walk to the gate lever and press E to shut it.
steps.goal: walk to the gate lever, press E

steps.title: Well done
steps.text: That is the basics. Next: the briefing card each morning, T for the News, G for the map and the pickup trip, and nights at the wall. The ? button lists every key.
steps.skipped_text: No problem. The ? button lists every key, and you can play Orientation Day again from the main menu whenever you like.
